description_text:
** This is a reprocess for the previously approved sourcing project EPIN06923S0013 due to vendors EIN issue.
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the PPB Rules, DSS/HRA Office of Communications and Marketing intends to enter into a Sole Source contract with Outfront Media Group, LLC for placing the Fair Fares campaign ads on buses and subways from 3/6/2023 to 6/11/2023. The total contract amount is $347,408.75
Outfront is the current advertising licensee for the MTA subway, commuter rail and bus systems. Outfront has the exclusive right to post and display advertising on those systems.
